# Introduction and preparation

## 1.1 Purpose

Describe the purpose of the NMEP data analytics products and how they support malaria program monitoring, decision-making, and reporting.

## 1.2 Software and access requirements

List the software versions, access permissions, packages, and accounts required for each workflow. Confirm these requirements against the actual workshop computers before finalizing the manual.

## 1.3 Project and data folder structure

Insert the actual folder structure used in the workshop. Explain where source datasets, scripts, outputs, geographic files, and documentation are stored.

## 1.4 Before starting the practical sessions

- Confirm that participants can access the required datasets.
- Confirm that R and RStudio are installed where needed.
- Confirm that required R packages are installed.
- Use a copy of the training data; do not experiment on production data.
- Confirm that participants have the required KoboToolbox access for the IRS session.

## Practical exercise

Ask participants to locate the training dataset, identify its reporting period, and identify the main geographic and indicator variables.
